Market orders generally prioritize immediate execution, but the execution price is not guaranteed; limit orders set a price boundary but may not be executed; stop‑loss orders convert to market orders when the stop price is reached, so in fast‑moving markets the execution price may deviate from the stop price. [1] FINRA also warns that quote delays, execution time, and volatility can cause the actual trade price to differ from the displayed quote. [2]

strings.ストップをブレイクイーブンに移すと単発の損失は減る可能性があるが、短期ノイズで洗: Moving the stop to breakeven can reduce a single loss but may increase the proportion of trades wiped out by short-term noise. Trailing/moving stops protect part of unrealized gains but can lower average returns. Both approaches must be validated with pre-defined rules and historical records; do not justify them as a collage of success stories.

strings.トレーディングプランはいつエントリーするかだけでなく、いつ諦めるかも書くべきです: A trading plan should state not only when to enter but also when to quit: if the expected spread exceeds your limit, if stop distance is so large that position size becomes too small, before/after major events, when signals occur only in low-liquidity periods, or when the day's loss limit has been reached. A plan without no-trade rules is likely to be rewritten on the spot under high pressure.

strings.バックテスト、アウト・オブ・サンプル、トレードログ、最大ドローダウンは付加的な項: Backtest, out-of-sample, trade logs, and maximum drawdown are not optional extras but the minimum requirements to turn subjective ideas into a falsifiable process.
strings.パラメータが多いほど、データを何度も見返すほど、過学習のリスクは高まります。コス: The more parameters you have and the more you re-examine the data, the higher the risk of overfitting. Double the costs, delay signals by one bar, reduce the fill rate, exclude top trades—check whether the strategy still maintains a reasonable risk/reward. If it only works with very specific strict parameters, the edge may be sample noise.

strings.ロングの計画はリスク距離 = Entry − Stop、報酬距離 = Targe: A long plan can be written as Risk distance = Entry − Stop, Reward distance = Target − Entry, Planned R:R = Reward distance ÷ Risk distance. For shorts, invert the price directions. This only describes the geometric distances of a single trade. To estimate whether a strategy has an edge, you must also use win rate, realized average profit, and realized average loss.

For grid trades, check inventory and margin after a one‑sided break; for leverage strategies, check liquidation price, margin top‑ups, and gaps. The same name does not imply the same risk. Attach clear stop conditions to strategy descriptions.

strings.先にリスクを定義し、その後報酬を定義する；すべての取引は失敗条件、最大損失、退出: Define risk first, then define reward; every trade must be able to describe failure conditions, maximum loss, and exit method.
strings.出入口のスリッページを割合で仮定する場合は方向ごとに適用してください：ロングの建: If entry/exit slippage is assumed as a percentage, apply it per direction: long positions incur higher slippage on entry and lower on exit; short opens (established by selling) are lower on open and higher on buyback. Fees are calculated on the actual executed amount; fixed costs, taxes, and stock borrow fees should be shown separately. Costs are a strategy parameter that change the breakeven win rate, not an ex-post “decimal.”
strings.十分なサンプルで実行上の問題と戦略上の問題を識別する。: Identify operational and strategic issues with a sufficient sample.
strings.単位あたりリスク＝|Entry−Stop|＋単位あたりコスト: Risk per unit = |Entry − Stop| + cost per unit
strings.取引を戦略、時間帯、方向、ボラティリティ環境、保有期間、流動性、ルール遵守の有無: Group trades by strategy, time of day, direction, volatility environment, holding period, liquidity, and rule compliance. Overall expectancy can be driven by a single strategy or a small number of days; only by grouping can you tell whether edge is concentrated, costs are eroding returns during certain periods, or rule violations are producing the main losses.

Multiple positions in the same industry, exposed to the same macro factors or currency direction can trigger stops simultaneously under stress. In reviews, calculate portfolio‑level maximum loss, same‑direction exposure, margin usage and liquidity, and avoid looking only at single trades.
strings.固定リスク比率、固定ドル建てのロットサイズ、資産に応じて変動するポジションでは、: Fixed risk ratios, fixed dollar-denominated lot sizes, and positions that vary with assets produce different drawdown paths. Before trading, assume stress scenarios (e.g., 5, 10, 15 consecutive losses) and check whether your remaining capital, psychological tolerance, or rules would have to change. After trading
strings.完全な取引記録は最低でも次を含むべき：日時、銘柄、方向、戦略タグ、エントリー理由: A complete trade record should include at minimum: date/time, ticker, direction, strategy tags, entry reason, failure conditions, planned Entry／Stop／Target, actual fills, position size, fees, slippage, exit reason, result R, rule compliance, and post-trade notes. Screenshots can capture the situation but do not replace structured fields.
strings.完成取引の実際コストの事後分布を確認する；取引前には使用できます: Examine the posterior distribution of actual costs for completed trades; can be used before trading.
strings.実戦トレードはチャートを速く操作することではなく、まず「どの条件でエントリーする: Real-world trading isn't about moving charts quickly; it begins with writing rules that state "under what conditions to enter, where to exit if you're wrong, what the maximum allowable loss is, how to execute, and how to validate." This article builds a Category 13 knowledge tree and connects trade planning, order execution, position management, strategy selection, backtesting, and the trade journal into a single chain of evidence. This category does not provide real-time signals and will not place orders automatically on behalf of users.

Do not rewrite a decision as acceptable just because a trade was profitable, and do not conclude that the original process was wrong simply because it produced a loss. Issues that can actually be improved are usually execution deviations, cost estimation, excessive position sizing, data definitions, or strategy malfunctions in specific environments.

strings.損益分岐勝率＝平均損失の絶対値 ÷（平均利益＋平均損失の絶対値）: Break-even win rate = |average loss| ÷ (average profit + |average loss|)
strings.最低でもシグナル形成時刻、発注時刻、注文種別、期待価格、約定価格、約定数量、キャ: At minimum, record the signal formation time, order submission time, order type, expected price, executed price, executed quantity, reason for cancel/modify, slippage, and unfilled quantity.
